payload.words: What was learned reaches later work through the Goal: a decided want is a line of a written Goal, a fact is a finding that any agent folds into the one Goal in work whose want it bears on, and hyp's reads show both without a guess at which issue or comment holds them.

lines.text: An agent records a finding with its fact and evidence and no Goal. hyp prints its id, and the finding is not folded.

A fold names one Goal in work (written, open or selected) and moves each named finding to folded into that Goal. hyp refuses a fold into an ended Goal or a missing Goal, and a fold of a refuted finding. A folded finding may be folded again.
A finding folded into a Goal that later ends reads folded into that Goal, ended. No act writes this, and a fold again is still allowed. Refuted stays the only final state.

`hyp finding list` prints every finding with its state, fact, evidence and the Goal it is folded into. It hides findings folded into an ended Goal unless `--all`, and `--not-folded` lists only the not folded ones. It prints the finding acts each listed finding allows as ready lines, and the line that records a new finding.
An agent may attach a drafted `add goal` (words, lines and why) to a not folded finding. `hyp finding list` prints it marked as the agent's draft, which the owner may edit and run.
`hyp status` prints the words of each written or open Goal, and one line that counts the not folded findings and names `hyp finding list --not-folded`. Ended Goals stay hidden unless `--all`.
`hyp add goal` takes a why, kept in git with the Goal, and `hyp status G` prints it under the words.
`hyp status G` lists each finding folded into G with its fact, evidence and state.

The skills tell an agent three things. A fact that no line of its Goal needs is a finding. The agent folds it into the Goal in work whose want it bears on, or drafts an `add goal` for the owner. Before a land, the grill shows the owner each decided part that no line builds, as a drafted `add goal` to run `--from` the Goal after the land.
Replaying the git log gives the same Goal states and refusals as on H0, and the guards and refusals of every Goal act are unchanged.
